_comment: Reflexive meaning copy of the runtime execution capacity.

#root.role: Return an echoed message through the wrapper runtime.

transformation_contract.morphing: An inbound message becomes an echoed payload returned through the wrapper runtime.
invariants: sandbox.echo must remain bounded by its declared inputs, outputs, and effects.
Internal implementation strategy may vary, but the declared contract surface must remain stable.
success: sandbox.echo returns payload and matter effects consistent with the declared outputs when it succeeds.
Successful execution preserves the semantic change described by morphing.
failure: sandbox.echo fails when required inputs or matter contracts are not satisfied.
The capacity fails when the underlying runtime or wrapper cannot satisfy the declared contract.
notes: This contract constrains expected behavior and observable effects, not the internal implementation decomposition.
Humans and LLMs should interpret the capacity through the declared interface and semantic guarantees first.
